expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and a black horizontal bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza card with the -20% badge) shows only an image — the restaurant name, rating, delivery time/fee and cuisine metadata row that the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has is absent, leaving blank space below the image.
In the bottom tab bar a thick black horizontal bar is drawn across the middle, overlapping and partially obscuring the search and bookmark/saved icons, so those tabs look broken and unreadable.

The favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark circular background with a white heart.
The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail (Green Bowl Poké) uses a light grey background while the sibling thumbnails use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look uneven.
Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, making their purpose ambiguous, and there is no visible active-state indication for the current tab.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 1 describes the same black bar overlapping and obscuring icons in the bottom navigation, though it does not mention the cut-off labels.
